description: After a drop graduates at its target, each mint is a request a keeper settles with a random item. When nft_drop_mint returned `pending` and the item still hasn't arrived, this pushes the drop's FIFO mint queue through this wallet's open requests (up to 10 per drop, all reported in `yourRequests`): each head whose randomness is ready is settled (its buyer gets the drawn item), each whose randomness expired (~3 minutes) is refunded (its buyer gets price + fee back). Requests ahead of yours go to THEIR buyers, never to you; you pay only network fees (a settle's rent is repaid in the same transaction, a refund may open the buyer's wCOOK account). Up to 5 heads per call; call again while any of `yourRequests` is still pending. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

collection.description: the drop's collection mint (or any of its items' mints)
